intro: Section A Arithmetical & Numerical Ability carries 20 marks in every DSSSB paper. In the 4 official 2023–24 TGT CS papers ({n} questions) almost half came from percentage, profit–loss–discount, simple and compound interest (including instalments), partnership, variation and ages; about a fifth from time–work, pipes, average speed, trains, boats and mixtures; the rest from HCF–LCM remainders, divisibility and long BODMAS fractions, mensuration of cones, cylinders and spheres, surds and text-form data interpretation. Most questions are SSC-CGL Tier-1 level with two or three steps. The notes give every formula with a worked DSSSB-level example and a shortcut.
